title.narrative: Fundación Grupo de Acción y Apoyo a personas Trans -GAAT-

description.narrative: The Trans Action and Support Group Foundation (GAAT) is a community-based organization in Colombia that defends, promotes and makes visible the rights and citizenship of trans people, based on individual, group and political transformation actions. The grant will support the following priorities and specific activities:- Adaptation of the office and the IPS (consultations for psychosocial care and legal care; support group room)- Sustainability of the P.R.E.D.I.V.A. Observatory of Violence- Increase the visibility of the Trans Talent Hire Program- Strengthen the organization's communication strategy- Increase the organization's service provision offer (psychosocial care, legal advice)
